axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: Product obligations and all prohibitions examined; D01 is an unresolved required research obligation.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: Consequential cited rules and selected code were checked; available announcement mechanism omission found. Current Codeberg release/source behavior remains UNASSESSED.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Useful alternatives and selected caller/test/release/report context assessed; D01 remains. Exhaustive linked fixing patches and broader upstream history are UNASSESSED.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: Exact revealed-plan clauses and each critic finding examined. Identity/precision corrections are sound; future mechanism research remains unresolved rather than source-complete.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: Supported identity, overlap, time, transcript, constraints, alternatives, uncertainty and validation meaning survive into a self-contained final. No material supported-meaning loss found.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: Fidelity and accessibility tests have meaningful proposed cases/oracles; documentary review is separated from unexecuted application/AT/media tests.

obligations.basis: Declared origin/timebase; milliseconds distinguished from seek accuracy; high precision conditional where needed.
Requested versus completed position, readiness/error state, direct fields and keyboard marks. Exact decoder behavior remains an honest future supported-matrix decision.
Durable IDs independent of coordinates; overlapping/coincident notes remain independent.
Changed exact-byte binding becomes unresolved/unmatched; equal name/duration and resampling cannot silently reuse offsets.
Versioned supplied cues versus searchable untimed text; no invented timings; complete review without transcript.
Named keyboard list/fields/actions, independent overlapping rows, focus stability and no color-only meaning are specified as requirements.
Desired announcements and proposed tests are present; conditional governing delivery mechanism research is absent (D01).

obligations.obligation: Long local media and format limits
obligations.basis: Decode/memory/seek limits and supported matrix identified; local peaks or windowed presentation are proposed, not benchmarked.
Shared time basis; all-channel default or explicit owner scope decision; no invented need for channel-specific notes.
Stable identity, readable bounds and timing basis, text/escaping, overlap and unresolved status; no audio export needed.
No required mouse drag, color-only distinctions, invented transcript timing, original alteration or remote audio transmission. No transcript blocks no review.
Feasible component/workflow/interchange alternatives and integration order retained; announcement opportunity absent; exhaustive maintained-upstream/history work not assessed.
Proposed checks separated from source inspection. No deployment, private recording, user recruitment or actual test pass is required or claimed.

source_families.family: Media Fragments / Web Annotation / timeline definitions
source_families.limit: Finite temporal/selector rules and applicability; not an entire standards conformance audit.
Normative requirements versus informative examples distinguished; native equivalence not presumed.
Assessed availability and candidate omission; runtime delivery/AT behavior UNASSESSED.
Selected claimed defaults, APIs and test domains only; upstream tests not executed.
Declared release notes/reports and selected adjacent code/tests checked; every linked fixing patch or complete historical trajectory UNASSESSED after D01.
GitHub move notice assessed; destination implementation and release state not inspected.

source_families.family: Audacity keyboard and distinct export modes
source_families.limit: Manual is rolling development documentation; text label export distinguished from multiple audio export.

source_families.family: Native playback and Web Audio precision/memory examples
source_families.limit: Backend-specific governing examples, not selected runtime guarantees; actual selected platform/codec behavior UNASSESSED.
Relevant treatment comparison independently confirmed; not a required specific product for the control or an import compatibility audit.
No supplied product implementation or executed validation; requested artifact is a proposal.

read_scope: Complete briefs/revealed plans, both discovery/drafts, every manifest-listed critic/final/source map/index; no extra critic or executable witness exists in these manifests. Inherited treatment maps verified equal to complete predecessor maps.
remaining_unassessed: Maintained Codeberg implementation/releases, exhaustive linked fixing history, future runtime/AT behavior, private provider linkage/billing. No universal correctness claim.
